Main work complete under the approved approach and the corrected epoch convention. `solution.py` executed in the workspace root and produced `signal_summary.csv` (4 rows) and `target_predictions.csv` (38 rows = exactly the 38 data rows of input_2.csv, order and id/time strings verbatim).

EPOCH CONFIRMATION: `input_0.json` explicitly contains `"reference_epoch_day": 0.0` (also `reference_epoch_day` is the only epoch field). Since it is 0.0, the fitted sine/cosine coefficients are already the u0 coefficients at the required epoch; no rotation was needed. The code nevertheless implements the general (t − reference_epoch_day) form in both fitting and prediction, and the predictions are epoch-invariant as required.

Presence decision (contract rule 5 applied): dchi2(A) = 192.4 / 290.2 / 9.8 / 105.2 for case_000..003 against threshold 30 (null scan-maximum expectation ~10–15 for chi2_2). case_002 is the absent case: its summary row has component_a_present=0 and component_a_period_day = component_a_basis1_u0 = component_a_basis2_u0 = 0, and all eight of its component_a_value_u0 entries are exactly 0.

Contract verification performed programmatically: exact headers in the required order with no index/extra columns; 4 summary rows with case_id strings exactly as in case_order; 38 prediction rows with (case_id, time_day) byte-identical to input_2.csv in input order; every prediction equals A1·sin(2π(t−t0)/P_A)+A2·cos(2π(t−t0)/P_A) of the summary (checked to 1e-6); all entries plain finite numeric scalars (no NaN/inf/units/text); absent-case fields all 0.
